assessment: This work shows that Kv3.3 potassium channels play a major role in shaping the presynaptic action potential waveform of calyx-type auditory synapses. Mice that lack Kv3.3 showed auditory response deficits, including increases of spike latency and jitter. Overall, the study shows the uniquely important role for Kv3.3 channels in the fast synaptic transmission between the neurons that compute sound localization in mammals.
